bio: The customer comes first in the elegant establishment of Delphine and Didier. Delphine’s vivacious personality depicts the front-of-house vibe, while Didier’s enthusiasm is contagious. The chef has a knack for adding a personal spin to fine produce and familiar flavours. He might add a playful edge to consummately crafted turbot, with different textures of parsley, all of which is enhanced by a spicy concoction of clams. The extensive menu embodies the establishment’s desire to pamper. First rate lunchtime menu....
